task: Pick the TextVQA curation slice that maximises the LoRA before/after gap
setup: 4-bit QLoRA (lora_r=16), cached vision_tower_hiddens path, official TextVQA accuracy, held-out curated val. Mirrors the notebook code path.
key_findings: text_dense (top-quartile OCR-token count) gives the clearest, most robust positive lift.
A gentle learning rate is essential: lr=3e-5 + ~300 steps lifts; the QLoRA-default lr=2e-4 over a few hundred rows mildly forgets and HURTS every slice.

The cached SFT tokens must carry 400 <|image_pad|> placeholders (LLM_TOKENS_PER_IMAGE) so the train loop masked_scatters the cached vision hiddens; otherwise training is blind to the image and degrades.

chosen.train_recipe: 4-bit QLoRA, lora_r=16, lr=3e-5, ~300 optimizer steps (bs=2, grad_accum=4)
chosen.baked_subset: lance-format/textvqa-lance-colab (600 train w/ cached hiddens, 400 held-out val)
